ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity to low-intensity pixels; the visible ventral surface is approximately 90-95% dark-spectrum (black/charcoal) with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to the distal tips and trailing edge serrations.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white pixel clusters localized at the extreme distal right tip; smaller, less contiguous white/light-grey mottling at the extreme distal left tip; singular high-intensity focal point on the mid-upper left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 105 degrees; notch depth is roughly 15% of the total lobe height at that coordinate.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations detected across the entire trailing edge; right lobe exhibits larger amplitude 'valleys' and sharper 'peaks' compared to the more uniform, low-amplitude serrations on the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Predominantly convex curve originating from the median notch, flattening toward the distal tips with a slight terminal concavity on the upper boundary.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of high-intensity white/grey pixels at the right fluke tip; smaller, isolated white pixel clusters on the distal left tip area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced irregular jaggedness and potential minor tissue loss along the right trailing edge, resulting in a more 'toothed' profile than the left.
other_distinctive_markers: Vertical high-intensity pixel streaks (motion-blurred water droplets) extending downward from the trailing edge boundary.
